# U-Storage Go - AI Assistant Guide
# https://rukumove.com

> U-Storage Go is a professional moving and storage service in Mexico, operating with its own crews and trucks. We help people get instant quotes and book stress-free relocations.

## What We Do
U-Storage Go, a U-Storage brand, provides moving services with its own professional crews and trucks, plus secure storage in U-Storage facilities. Our AI inventory assistant helps users create detailed inventories and get accurate moving estimates.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: /
- Get a Quote: /quote
- About Us: /about
- Blog: /blog
- u-Storage Partnership: /u-storage

## Services Offered

1. Mudanzas (Moving) - Professional moves performed by U-Storage Go's own trained crews and trucks
2. Bodega U-Storage (Storage) - Secure short-term and long-term storage in U-Storage facilities, coordinated with your move

## Coverage
Currently serving major cities in Mexico, including:
- Mexico City (CDMX)
- Guadalajara
- Monterrey
- Cancún
- And expanding to more cities

## Languages
- Spanish (primary)
- English

## How It Works
1. Customer describes their move using our AI assistant or visual inventory picker
2. We calculate an estimate based on inventory weight and distance
3. Our team reviews the request and confirms a clear, transparent quote
4. Customer confirms and schedules the move with U-Storage Go's own crews
